summary: Anthropic is giving existing Claude Pro and Max subscribers a one-time credit to try Claude Code cloud sessions, which left research preview on September 23, 2026: $100 on Pro, $250 on Max. The credit is separate from plan usage limits, applies automatically once a cloud session starts, and is limited to one credit per account for cloud sessions only. Must be claimed by October 7, 2026.
claim_steps: You need an existing Claude Pro or Max subscription.
Claim at https://claude.ai/code/claim-credit/10 or run /claim-credit in the Claude Code CLI.
Connect GitHub - required to start a cloud session.
Claim by October 7, 2026. The credit applies automatically once you start a cloud session; one credit per account, cloud sessions only.

social_proof.author: ClaudeDevs
social_proof.text: Follow the link below to claim the credit or run /claim-credit in the CLI. You'll need GitHub connected to start a session. Claim by Oct 7. Terms apply.

social_proof.author: ClaudeDevs
social_proof.text:
Cloud sessions are officially available and out of research preview! They let you keep Claude Code working, even when your laptop is closed.

Existing subscribers get a one-time credit to try them: $100 on Pro, $250 on Max.

social_proof.author: ClaudeDevs
social_proof.text:
The credit is separate from your usage limits, and it applies automatically once you start a cloud session.

If you hit a limit locally, keep going in the cloud until your credit runs out. One credit per account, for cloud sessions only.

social_proof.title: Use Claude Code in the cloud
social_proof.text: Cloud sessions are available on Pro, Max, and Team plans, and for Enterprise users with premium seats or Chat + Claude Code seats.

social_proof.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Code Cloud Sessions With Trial Credits for Subscribers
social_proof.text: Users subscribed to the Pro plan receive a $100 trial credit to evaluate the feature across their active code repositories. Meanwhile, subscribers enrolled in the higher-tier Max plan receive a $250 trial credit.
